brief: Coffee futures closed at 287¢/lb — down 6.6% on the week and down 0.4% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 33 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (-0.0σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is low. A weakening Brazilian real (+4.0% in a month) raises producers' local-currency revenue per bag — added selling pressure. Looking ahead: the 14-day forecast calls for 32 mm of rain in the robusta belt against a 96 mm seasonal norm (-0.8σ) — projected crop stress: low (Open-Meteo forecast model, issued 2026-10-31; skill scored publicly as windows close).
